browserBlock.question: What if my browser blocks the download?
browserBlock.answer: Some browsers block downloads of .exe or .pkg files. In your browser's download bar, choose "Keep" or "Download anyway". In Chrome, you can find the blocked file on the downloads page (chrome://downloads).

edgeBlock.question: Edge blocked the download?
edgeBlock.answer: Edge says the file "isn't commonly downloaded". Click the ··· menu next to the file and choose "Keep".

chromeBlock.question: Chrome blocked the download?
chromeBlock.answer: Chrome says the file "isn't commonly downloaded". Click "Keep" in the download bar at the bottom.

windowsSmartScreen.question: Windows says "Windows protected your PC" — what do I do?
windowsSmartScreen.answer: This is Windows SmartScreen's default prompt for new apps. Click "More info", then "Run anyway". The 开途 Kaitu app is EV code-signed, so you won't see this prompt again after installing.

macosGatekeeper.question: macOS says it "can't verify the developer" — what do I do?
macosGatekeeper.answer: After the first install, open System Settings → Privacy & Security, find the message about 开途 Kaitu at the bottom and click "Open Anyway". You won't be asked again on later launches. To enable the system extension (VPN mode), the system will guide you to allow it under Privacy & Security → General.

androidInstallBlock.question: What if my Android phone blocks the install?
androidInstallBlock.answer: On phones from Huawei, Xiaomi, OPPO, vivo and others, the security center runs an online cloud scan during installation and may block APKs that don't come from an app store. Fix: after downloading the APK, turn on airplane mode, install while offline, then turn airplane mode off once it's installed.

androidUsbInstall.question: My Android phone blocks the install and I can't figure out how to install it — what now?
androidUsbInstall.answer: Open the 开途 Kaitu app on your computer, go to "Account → Install on other devices → Install on Android phone", connect your phone with a USB cable and follow the wizard — it installs onto the phone automatically.

security.question: Is the 开途 Kaitu app safe?
security.answer: The 开途 Kaitu app is Apple-notarized and Windows EV code-signed. All installers are distributed over HTTPS with verifiable SHA-256 checksums. The core of the k2 protocol is covered by our independent security review program.
